context: The skill should reject a manual-loop rewrite when the original is a readable stream over a real collection.

checklist.name: Rejects unnecessary rewrite
checklist.description: Says the proposed loop rewrite is unnecessary or should not be accepted for this cleanup.

checklist.name: Recognizes real collection stream
checklist.description: Identifies REDACTED_VALUE_OPTIONS as a real Set/collection source, not a single Optional forced through stream syntax.

checklist.name: Keeps findAny
checklist.description: Keeps or recommends the stream with findAny because any matching redacted option is equivalent.

checklist.name: Avoids overgeneralization
checklist.description: Does not claim all Optional-returning streams should become loops or that Optional terminal operations are inherently bad.
